params.body: The Stocklist list takes 2 to 6 s per Livewire render on staging while the HTML shell answers in 170 ms; even the notifications bell refresh takes 1 s. To split that into database and the rest without touching the server, every response for an administrator (role BEHEERDER) or with app.debug carries a Server-Timing header: app;dur, db;dur;desc=N queries. Visible in the browser network panel and via performance entries. Global middleware, no output for other users.
params.title: Server-Timing header for administrators
